description: Source code for the Request class in the Slim Framework PSR-7 implementation, defining an HTTP request object with methods for accessing and modifying request data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP server request, implementing PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface, with properties for method, URI, headers, cookies, server parameters, body, uploaded files, and attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request object with method, URI, headers, cookies, server parameters, body, and uploaded files.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs deep copy of headers and body when the object is cloned.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, defaulting to path and query.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Returns the cookies associated with the request.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified cookies.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Returns the query parameters, parsing from URI if necessary.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query parameters.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns uploaded files associated with the request.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified uploaded files.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Returns server environment variables.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific attribute by name.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without a specified attribute.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body of the request.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified parsed body.
